original.target_description: Study 2: undergraduates recalling meaningful versus trivial secrets while throwing a beanbag at a target 265 cm away; Mann–Whitney U comparison of signed throwing distances.

n.location: pp. 620–621 (PDF pp. 2–3), Study 2 Method and Results
n.quote: Thirty-six undergraduates (75% female; Mage! 19) recalled a meaningful or trivial personal secret
n.sample_role: Participants in the target between-condition test
n.exclusions: No exclusions reported in Study 2; the stated sample is used in the reported between-condition analysis, with no reduced sample identified.

replication.target_description: Experiment 3: 118 Erasmus University Rotterdam participants; big versus small secret effect on longitudinal signed beanbag throwing error, two-tailed independent-samples t test.

n.location: p. e70 (PDF p. 6), Experiment 3 Participants and Results
n.quote: A group of 118 participants was recruited at Erasmus University Rotterdam to participate for course credit or a snack.
n.sample_role: Participants in the target between-condition test
n.exclusions: No participants were excluded from this analysis.

reported_success.quote: Thus, we did not replicate Slepian et al.’s finding

notes: Titles and DOIs verified in retrieved primary full texts. PDF text extraction renders some original-paper equals signs as !; statistics transcribed as printed numeric values without conversion. The original reports a Mann–Whitney U statistic and p, but no standardized effect size for this test. Requested d is therefore null; no conversion performed. The replication uses a t test and a floor cross instead of the original colander target.
